preconditions.name: consumed_candidate_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_ALL_ON mean cand_world_pairwise_dist (the e2.world_forward per-candidate spread; post-GAP-A this IS the representation the curiosity novelty consumes) clears the floor -- a cross-candidate RANGE, the SAME statistic and floor V3-EXQ-649 cleared at 0.090.
preconditions.control: ARM_ALL_ON (all three sub-flavours on), P1 ticks; positive control = the arm where the curiosity channel is loudest; curiosity_candidate_source=e2_world_forward (SD-056-trained)

preconditions.name: curiosity_bias_range_supra_floor
preconditions.description: 604c LOAD-BEARING same-statistic gate: ARM_ALL_ON mean per-candidate curiosity_bias_range (max-minus-min of the curiosity bias across the K candidates, from the score-bias decomposition) -- the EXACT cross-candidate RANGE C1 routes on and the authority rescales -- clears the floor. This is the leg 604b LACKED: 604b gated on bias MAGNITUDE (last_bias_max_abs), and a uniform per-tick offset has large magnitude but ~0 range, so the gate read READY while the argmin could not move (same-statistic confound behind 604a/624a/614d/614e/604b). Below-floor here -> the bias still collapsed (substrate not ready / source not wired) -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a MECH-314 falsification.
preconditions.control: ARM_ALL_ON positive control with curiosity_candidate_source=e2_world_forward; the SAME range statistic the load-bearing C1 consumes (not a magnitude / mean_abs proxy)

preconditions.name: primary_scores_bounded_fraction_supra_floor
preconditions.description: fraction of P1 ticks (across all arms) with primary e3_raw_score_range_mean < 1000.0 -- non-vacuity: an authority fire on exploded SD-056-online scores is a degenerate artifact, not a real effect. A FLOOR on a fraction (measured >= threshold), so no upper-bound directionality trap.
